name: Imouto ni Yokujou Nante Hentai Ja Nai? ~Kuro Gyaru Imouto no Onii-chan Ijiri~
original_name: 妹に欲情なんて変態じゃない？～黒ギャル妹のお兄ちゃん弄り～
source: The protagonist is an adult virgin that can't take it anymore and starts to molest a pretty girl on train, only to discover that it was actually his little sister. She then decides to blackmail him into having sexual acts with her, it turns out they are very compatible.
translation: 主角是一个成年处女，再也受不了了，开始在火车上猥亵一个漂亮女孩，却发现那竟然是他的妹妹。然后她决定勒索他与她发生性行为，事实证明他们非常合适。
